description: Searches French companies via the official open API (recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr, Licence Ouverte v2). Returns legal name, SIREN, head-office SIRET and address, legal form, NAF activity code (no label in the API), creation date, status, size band, and directors when published. Rate limit: ~10 req/s (API's own limit). `limit` max 25. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

q.description: Company name, SIREN (9 digits) or SIRET (14 digits) to search
